title: inf kill all
features: inf kill all (also new players who joined after you execute script)
script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local players = game:GetService("Players")

while true do
    for _, p in pairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player then
            local args = {
                players:WaitForChild(p.Name),
                1000
            }
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PlayerHitEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
        end
    end
    wait(0.1)
end
